interpretation.visual: Readability requires separate human inspection; no universal small-size readability claim.

observations: The current WOFF2 font samples remain visibly rendered at 11-14 CSS px. Existing dense Han remain crowded at 11px/DPR1 and some dense interiors merge; no broad small-size legibility claim is made.
The old 32-symbol regression rows and tabular-number rows retain their expected shapes and layout in the inspected native and nearest-neighbor views.
